product_metadata.title: 5-Shelf Foldable Storage Shelves with Wheels, Large Capacity Shelving Unit, Freestanding Metal Wire Shelf Rack, No Assembly Organizer Rack for Garage Kitchen, Basement, Pantry, Heavy Duty White
features: 【Free Installation Shelving Unit】The pre-assembled shelving unit takes the hassle out of installation for you and lays out in 5 seconds. With 4 wheels, it's easy to push it anywhere. Foldable design for easy carrying and storage.

【Stable&Durbale Storage Shelf】The metal shelf is made of highly durable iron, anti-rust and anti-corrosion and stable.Holds up to 600 pounds without wheels (120 lbs/shelf), and 300 with wheels (60 lbs/shelf).

【Perfect Size】Open size.24.2 x 11.1 x 59"The height on each layer not only creat more additional space but also keep your home clean and orderly. Folded size.24.2 x3.9 x59". The storage rack can be stored under bed, behind doorways and so on, It will not take up more space when not in use.

【Large Lockable Wheels】The utility shelf comes with 4 easy-glide durable rubber wheels with 360° rotation. 2 with and 2 without brakes make the rolling kitchen cart more stable don't worry about slipping. The mesh shelves on both sides can also prevent objects from falling.

【Multi-usage Shelving】This metal shelving unit meets various multi-purpose storage needs for home, garage, business, warehouse, schools, storage and office .Perfects for storing tools, books and what ever is taking up space.

details.Included Components: 1 x user manual, 1 x storage shelf, 4 x wheels
